name: Active Sample Preparation
description: Preparation of IC samples that must remain electrically functional after preparation. This is the most demanding form of sample preparation, required for fault injection (laser, EMFI), microprobing, FIB circuit editing, and active SEM techniques (voltage contrast, EBIC). Covers backside silicon substrate thinning (mechanical polishing, CMP, plasma/wet etch) to controlled remaining thickness, maintaining bond wire and solder ball integrity during preparation, electrical verification at each preparation stage, custom PCB adapter and socket fabrication for prepared samples, and thermal management of thinned die during operation.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to active sample preparation

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands why active preparation differs from passive and the constraints involved
evidence: Can explain why device functionality must be preserved for fault injection, probing, and FIB editing
Understands the concept of backside thinning and remaining silicon thickness targets for different analysis types
Aware of the risks: die cracking, bond wire damage, thermal issues, ESD damage to thinned die

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs backside thinning on standard packages under supervision with electrical verification
evidence: Removes package substrate/heatspreader to expose backside of die without damaging bond wires or solder connections
Performs mechanical backside thinning on a standard flip-chip or wire-bond package under guidance
Verifies device functionality after each preparation stage using basic electrical tests
Mounts prepared sample on test PCB/socket adapter for continued electrical access

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently prepares active samples to target thickness for specified analysis technique
evidence: Thins silicon substrate to target remaining thickness (e.g., ~50-100µm for backside LFI and IR photon-emission imaging, <10µm for backside FIB access) with consistent results
Selects appropriate thinning technique (mechanical, CMP, plasma, wet etch) based on target thickness and uniformity requirements
Fabricates custom adapter PCBs or modifies sockets for electrical access to prepared samples
Achieves >80% yield on active sample preparations across a batch

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex packages and extreme thinning requirements; develops preparation procedures
evidence: Prepares advanced packages (PoP, 2.5D/3D, fan-out WLP) while maintaining functionality of target die
Achieves sub-10µm remaining silicon thickness with controlled uniformity for backside FIB access
Designs and fabricates thermal management solutions (heat sinks, active cooling) for thinned die under operation
Develops preparation procedures for new device types and mentors team on yield optimization

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines active preparation methodology; pushes limits of what can be prepared alive
evidence: Defines the lab's active sample preparation SOPs, yield targets, and quality criteria
Specifies thinning and polishing equipment for active sample preparation procurement
Develops techniques for preparing samples at bleeding-edge nodes where substrate thickness is already minimal
Trains teams, conducts proficiency assessments, and drives continuous improvement in preparation yield

assessment_methods.description: Prepare an active sample from a packaged IC: decap, backside thin to target thickness, verify functionality, mount on test adapter. Assessed on remaining thickness accuracy, device functionality, and process documentation.
Observe full active preparation workflow including electrical verification checkpoints, handling of thinned die, and ESD precautions
Review preparation logs including thickness measurements, electrical test results at each stage, and final yield data

equipment: Silicon substrate thinning/polishing system (mechanical + CMP capability)
IR microscope or IR camera for remaining thickness verification through silicon
Profilometer or interferometer for thickness and planarity measurement
Custom PCB fabrication capability (for test adapter boards)
ESD-safe workstation with device-specific test fixtures
Thermal management components (heat sinks, Peltier coolers, thermal interface materials)
